description: Phase 3b v4: v3 (0.08-3 C, same inputs, box, design configs/lispan_chem_design_v3.json) with the HARD CHARGE INVENTORY (inventory_hard): the time argument of the extents is scaled per (t, condition) so that c_S4,0 int sum xi dy = Q(t) / (2 F L_cat) holds exactly (root solve + two differentiable Newton steps; exact first and mixed second derivatives).  v3 plateaued at ~4.7 mV outside cliffs with a late-discharge drift from this inventory (docs/PHASE3B_CHEM_PINN.md, 'v3 results').  The charge_total residual is then ~1e-9 (kept as a diagnostic).  ~1.1-1.2 s per step in the sandbox (2x v3: second-order graph through the extent network at the quadrature nodes), so 250 000 steps take ~85-95 h on one Grace core: submit with --time=120:00:00 (partition long).
